record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly increase batch size from 128 to 256 and learning rate from 6e-4 to 8e-4. Larger batches may reduce gradient noise, permitting moderately faster updates while retaining width 48 and dropout 0.10. Keep features, embedding tying, six causal blocks, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer type fixed. Train one independent model per category with seed 42, at most 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per epoch.
